I changed `get_typed_signature` in `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` to call `inspect.signature(call, eval_str=True)` on Python 3.10+, so stringified annotations are resolved there. The patch is submitted (one file changed).

I did not reproduce the Python 3.10 failure, because the sandbox runs Python 3.13. The existing `test_annotated.py` and `test_return_none_stringified_annotations.py` tests pass (14 tests), and a `from __future__ import annotations` app still works. This is a best guess at the fix, modelled on the typer PR the issue references, and I did not add tests.
